data.desc: Corpay (NYSE: CPAY), the Corporate Payments and Expense Management Company, is an S&P 500 company with three primary B2B solution sets. Spend Management, provides corporate and virtual card programs and automates procure-to-pay. Cross-Border converts foreign currencies and establishes foreign bank accounts. Vehicle Solutions, controls fuel, tolls, parking and related vehicle spend. With Corpay, the more a business controls, the less it spends.
